title: File:Baie Saint-Paul vu du nord.jpg
claims: The Commons file is a view of Baie-Saint-Paul, Quebec, from the north, showing the town and the Saint Lawrence River.
The image is a general location photograph of the town, not a photograph of the QMT135 race.
The author is OnionneRing, credited under CC BY-SA 4.0; the original file is 1,400 x 1,050 pixels.
The file page requires attribution and share-alike; the route page uses a 960 x 720 Commons thumbnail and credits the author and licence.
